note: One accepted outside-stock and budget publication as a typed evidence study, referenced from Road, Ship and Air. It is not pooled with the outside-query, rail or native studies, it is not a qualification, promise or certificate, and no archived scorer, collector or game runs as a product check.

outside-stock-budget-v1.title: Frozen outside-query stock validation and road budget limits
outside-stock-budget-v1.scope: One prospective stock validation and one separate retained-road budget intervention on unchanged Cities: Skylines packages. The stock half asks whether the frozen lane:any_lane:forbidden rule and the weak_component reference predict new literal outside-connection requests on packages never opened in the earlier cohorts. The budget half repeats eight old road requests under three predeclared requested maxLength floats. Neither half is a product port, a qualification, a certificate, a map repair or a promise.
outside-stock-budget-v1.method: The stock catalog and the frozen rules, selected requests, predictions and controls were written before any new native request; the first Asanu control opening then failed before a single path query and was retained without retry. Eight further openings produced the stock labels and the budget repeats. This ledger re-checks the archived bytes, reconstructs the integrity table, and re-derives the saved population, request, label, bridge, control, intervention, runtime and cleanup arithmetic. It does not run the frozen scorer, the post-control scorer, the audit, the collectors or the game, and it does not rejudge or replace an old label.
outside-stock-budget-v1.limits: Descriptive and status-scoped: 48 correlated new stock requests agree with the primary rule 28 TP / 0 FP / 20 TN / 0 FN, but all three modes remain UNQUALIFIED because the retained all-controls completion requirement fails on the first Asanu opening. Only 16 road requests on the first two packages have exact export/native field identity; the other 32 requests are not exact bridge matches. The weak reference's 12 road false positives show that weak connectivity cannot represent lane-direction restrictions; they are descriptive disagreements, not geographic negatives. Ship and air carry one class on some packages, so their arithmetic precision of 1 carries no information there. The budget intervention is a separate correlated observation stratum, not a holdout and not a rejudge: four retained road errors fail at 100000, 200000 and 1000000, and one matched old-success request fails at 100000 and succeeds at both larger budgets. That is a measured response, not an identified search-budget mechanism, cost or metre conversion; all four error mechanisms remain Unknown. The requested floats and the returned flags=8/length sentinel are not proof of native exhaustion. The Pittsburgh 093 group's all-mode graph changed during its opening, so it is not a clean single-variable trial. This is not qualification, global accuracy, a geographic 'no', a service, spawning or sustained-navigation evidence, or a promise, and it does not transfer to the current runtime checker, the live estimate, a certificate or any other study. File identity is not memory attestation or a strict no-mods claim; dynamic exclusions, plugin state and the three DLL errors remain limitations. Cleanup coverage is a historical statement about named PID/start identities, not a description of blade's current slot or process state. Stock packages carry no invented physical-input or CPU lineage; old exports retain only their exact CRP and old receipts. Observation windows are the recorded driver start/finish times, and they are not replaced by the freeze or publication time.

population.limit: Selection tags overlap across packages and modes and are not independent samples; the five selected packages are three queried cases plus two metadata-only unsupported cases, not eight.

requests.limit: No request was replaced, retried or relabelled. The six Unknown controls stay Unknown, and an unobserved request never becomes a negative.

stock.qualification_reason: The retained all-controls completion requirement fails on the first Asanu opening, so every mode stays unqualified even though the primary rule matches all 48 labels.

subset.note: Only these 16 road requests have exact export/native field identity. The other 32 requests fail exact bridge identity and are not admitted to this subset.

bridge.post_opening_diagnostic: Applying the unchanged rule to opening-native fields reproduces the classifications, but that is a post-outcome diagnostic, never a replacement pre-export prediction or an exact bridge subset.
bridge.scope: Bridge differences are retained and inspected per selected package. Ship and air endpoint heights change at opening while horizontal coordinates do not; the CL Roslyn Peninsula road prefabs change from Highway to Highway Connection on four segments. No lane, connectivity, Invert or Outside-role mismatch was observed.

drift.scope: Opening-to-post-batch drift is reported separately from the bridge. CL Roslyn Peninsula changes seven air and two ship endpoint heights, and three pre/post-query fingerprints change; the budget-01 opening changes two air endpoint heights. The publication reports 17 of 18 opening-fingerprint mismatches against the query-freeze opening graph; the ledger does not re-run that comparison because the freeze is linked, but it does re-derive that every pre-query model-field fingerprint differs from the recorded per-mode opening snapshot.

schema_repair.scope: The original frozen scorer omitted the transport's ok=true field; its retained failure is evidence. The separate post-control scorer requires exactly the frozen body keys plus ok=true. This is a schema correction, not a hidden re-freeze: no rule, request, native row, label, threshold or qualification gate changed.

integrity_reconstruction.reconstruction: Every carried member is re-hashed and every linked member's pinned hash is corroborated by the carried retention, source-fix, evaluation, audit, build and header records. The publication's own exact-byte replay of the 105 raw members is recorded, not re-run.

documents_semantics.results_claims: The page quotes the report's own counts and bounds verbatim where it states them; the importer re-derives every count it can from carried bytes and refuses a document that lost one of those claims.

limitations.correlated: Requests, reciprocal pairs, lanes and repeated openings of one package are correlated, not independent votes.
limitations.one_class: Empty strata and absent native classes are not estimable; arithmetic precision can be 1 with no information.
limitations.unqualified: All three modes remain unqualified after the retained first-control failure.
limitations.unknown_mechanisms: All four retained road error mechanisms remain Unknown; a requested float and flags=8 are not exhaustion proof.
limitations.no_geography: No request is a geographic negative, and no result is a service, spawning or sustained-navigation claim.
limitations.file_identity: File identity is not memory attestation or a strict no-mods claim; dynamic exclusions, plugin state and three DLL errors remain.
limitations.cleanup_history: Cleanup coverage is historical; it is not blade's current slot or process state.
limitations.no_lineage: Stock packages carry no invented physical-input/CPU lineage; old exports retain only their exact CRP and receipts.
limitations.no_transfer: This evidence does not transfer agreement to the current runtime checker, the live estimate, a certificate or any other study.
limitations.observation_dates: Observation windows are the recorded driver start/finish times, never the freeze or publication time.
